# anthropic_invite (Resource)

Manages an organization invitation (`/v1/organizations/invites`). Invites are immutable; changing `email` or `role` replaces the invitation. **Note:** In Claude Enterprise organizations with JIT (Just-In-Time) SSO or SCIM provisioning enabled, `/v1/organizations/invites` returns HTTP 400 and cannot be used to provision users.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address of the invited user.
- `role` (String) Organization-level role to grant upon acceptance (`user`, `developer`, `billing`, `admin`, `claude_code_user`, `membership_admin`, `managed`).

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the invitation expires.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the invite (`invite_...`).
- `invited_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the invitation was sent.
- `status` (String) Current status of the invite (`pending`, `accepted`, `expired`, `deleted`).
- `type` (String) Object type (`invite`).
